import numpy as np, itertools
from scipy import ndimage

def objects(g):
    g=np.array(g); bg=np.bincount(g.ravel()).argmax()
    out=[]
    for c in np.unique(g):
        if c==bg: continue
        lbl,n=ndimage.label(g==c, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
        for i in range(1,n+1):
            m=(lbl==i)
            r=np.where(m.any(1))[0]; co=np.where(m.any(0))[0]
            out.append((int(c),int(r[0]),int(co[0]),m[r[0]:r[-1]+1, co[0]:co[-1]+1]))
    return out

def transform(grid):
    g=np.array(grid); out=g.copy()
    objs=objects(g)
    # differing-color identical-shape pairs
    pairs=[]
    for a,b in itertools.combinations(range(len(objs)),2):
        ca,ra,cca,sa=objs[a]; cb,rb,ccb,sb=objs[b]
        if ca!=cb and sa.shape==sb.shape and (sa==sb).all():
            pairs.append((sa.size,a,b))
    if not pairs: return out.tolist()
    _,a,b=max(pairs)
    ca,_,_,_=objs[a]; cb,_,_,_=objs[b]
    na=sum(1 for o in objs if o[0]==ca); nb=sum(1 for o in objs if o[0]==cb)
    # member with fewer objects of its color (ties: smaller color) gets recolored
    tgt = a if (na,ca)<=(nb,cb) else b
    ct = objs[tgt][0]
    paired={objs[x][0] for p in pairs for x in p[1:]}

from scipy import ndimage

def objects(g):
    g=np.array(g); bg=np.bincount(g.ravel()).argmax()
    out=[]
    for c in np.unique(g):
        if c==bg: continue
        lbl,n=ndimage.label(g==c, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
        for i in range(1,n+1):
            m=(lbl==i)
            r=np.where(m.any(1))[0]; co=np.where(m.any(0))[0]
            out.append((int(c),int(r[0]),int(co[0]),m[r[0]:r[-1]+1, co[0]:co[-1]+1]))
    return out

def transform(grid):
    g=np.array(grid); out=g.copy()
    objs=objects(g)
    pairs=[]
    for a,b in itertools.combinations(range(len(objs)),2):
        ca,ra,cca,sa=objs[a]; cb,rb,ccb,sb=objs[b]
        if ca!=cb and sa.shape==sb.shape and (sa==sb).all():
            pairs.append((sa.size,a,b))
    if not pairs: return out.tolist()
    _,a,b=max(pairs)
    ca=objs[a][0]; cb=objs[b][0]
    na=sum(1 for o in objs if o[0]==ca); nb=sum(1 for o in objs if o[0]==cb)
    tgt = a if (na,ca)<=(nb,cb) else b
    paired={objs[x][0] for p in pairs for x in p[1:]}
    cands=[c for c in np.unique(g) if c not in paired and not any(o[0]==c and o[3].size==1 for o in objs)]
    newc=min(cands)
    m=objs[tgt][3]; r0=objs[tgt][1]; c0=objs[tgt][2]
    rr,cc=np.where(m)
    for r,c in zip(rr,cc): out[r0+r, c0+c]=newc
    return out.tolist()
''')

import numpy as np, itertools
from scipy import ndimage

def objects8(g):
    g=np.array(g); bg=np.bincount(g.ravel()).argmax()
    out=[]
    for c in np.unique(g):
        if c==bg: continue
        lbl,n=ndimage.label(g==c, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
        for i in range(1,n+1):
            m=(lbl==i)
            r=np.where(m.any(1))[0]; co=np.where(m.any(0))[0]
            cells=set(zip(*np.where(m)))
            out.append(dict(c=int(c),r0=int(r[0]),c0=int(co[0]),cells=cells,area=len(cells),
                            bbox=(int(r[-1]-r[0]+1),int(co[-1]-co[0]+1))))
    return out

def mindist(A,B):
    return min(abs(a[0]-b[0])+abs(a[1]-b[1]) if False else max(abs(a[0]-b[0]),abs(a[1]-b[1])) for a in A for b in B)

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=np.array(G[name+' input']); go=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    objs=objects8(gi)
    ch=[(i,o) for i,o in enumerate(objs) if any(gi[r,c]!=go[r,c] for r,c in o['cells'])]
    ci=ch[0][0]; chg=objs[ci]; newc=int(go[list(chg['cells'])[0]])
    print('==',name,'changed obj',chg['c'],'area',chg['area'],'bbox',chg['bbox'],'at',chg['r0'],chg['c0'],'->',newc)
    # its twin
    twins=[(i,o) for i,o in enumerate(objs) if i!=ci and o['area']==chg['area'] and o['bbox']==chg['bbox']]
    # exact shape match
    twins=[(i,o) for i,o in twins if o['cells']=={(r-chg['r0'],c-chg['c0']) for r,c in chg['cells']}]
    for i,tw in twins:
        print('   twin:',tw['c'],'at',tw['r0'],tw['c0'],'dist(min cheb):',mindist(chg['cells'],tw['cells']))
    tobjs=[o for o in objs if o['c']==newc]
    for t in tobjs:
        print('   target-color obj at',t['r0'],t['c0'],'area',t['area'],
              '| d(chg)=',mindist(chg['cells'],t['cells']),' d(twin)=',mindist(twins[0][1]['cells'],t['cells']))
    # all exact pairs
    print('   all exact pairs:')
    for a,b in itertools.combinations(range(len(objs)),2):
        A,B=objs[a],objs[b]
        if A['bbox']==B['bbox'] and A['area']==B['area'] and A['cells']=={(r-A['r0'],c-A['c0']) for r,c in B['cells']}:
            print('     ',A['c'],(A['r0'],A['c0']),'area',A['area'],'<->',B['c'],(B['r0'],B['c0']))
    # color counts
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(o['c'] for o in objs)
    print('   color obj counts:',dict(cnt))

def objects4(g):
    g=np.array(g); bg=np.bincount(g.ravel()).argmax()
    out=[]

                cells=set(zip(*np.where(m))),area=int(m.sum()),
                bbox=(int(r[-1]-r[0]+1),int(co[-1]-co[0]+1))))
    return out

def analyze(name):
    gi=np.array(G[name+' input']); go=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    objs=objects8(gi)
    ci=[i for i,o in enumerate(objs) if any(gi[r,c]!=go[r,c] for r,c in o['cells'])][0]
    chg=objs[ci]; newc=int(go[list(chg['cells'])[0]])
    twin=[o for i,o in enumerate(objs) if i!=ci and match(o,chg)][0]
    print('==',name,'| changed:',chg['c'],'at',(chg['r0'],chg['c0']),'->',newc,'| twin:',twin['c'],'at',(twin['r0'],twin['c0']))
    for o in objs:
        best=None
        for p in objs:
            if p is o: continue
            d=mindist(o['cells'],p['cells'])
            if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,p['c'],(p['r0'],p['c0']),p['area'])
        tag=''
        if o is chg: tag=' <== CHANGED'
        if o is twin: tag=' <== twin'
        print(f"   obj {o['c']} at ({o['r0']},{o['c0']}) area {o['area']:3d} bbox {o['bbox']} nn: d{best[0]} -> {best[1]} at {best[2]} a{best[3]}{tag}")

for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']: analyze(n)

import numpy as np
def cheb(A,B): return min(max(abs(a[0]-b[0]),abs(a[1]-b[1])) for a in A for b in B)
def objects8(g):
    g=np.array(g); bg=np.bincount(g.ravel()).argmax()
    lab,n=ndimage.label(g!=bg, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        cells=[tuple(x) for x in np.argwhere(lab==i)]
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        out.append(dict(c=int(g[cells[0]]), cells=cells, r0=min(rs), c0=min(cs), area=len(cells)))
    return out
def match(a,b):
    ca=sorted((r-a['r0'],c-a['c0']) for r,c in a['cells'])
    cb=sorted((r-b['r0'],c-b['c0']) for r,c in b['cells'])
    return ca==cb
def transform(grid):
    gi=np.array(grid).copy(); objs=objects8(gi)
    for A in objs:
        cands=[(cheb(A['cells'],o['cells']),o) for o in objs if o['c']!=A['c']]
        if not cands: continue
        dmin=min(d for d,_ in cands)
        if dmin!=2: continue
        d2=[o for d,o in cands if d==2]
        if len(d2)!=1: continue
        twins=[T for T in objs if T is not A and match(T,A)]
        if len(twins)!=1: continue
        T=twins[0]; B=d2[0]
        if T['c']==B['c']: continue
        for (r,c) in T['cells']: gi[r,c]=B['c']
    return gi.tolist()
'''

src2 = '''
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage

def canon(cells):
    cs=[(r,c) for r,c in cells]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cs); c0=min(c for r,c in cs)
    return tuple(sorted((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cs))

def objects8(g):
    g=np.array(g); bg=np.bincount(g.ravel()).argmax()
    out=[]
    for c in np.unique(g):
        if c==bg: continue
        lbl,n=ndimage.label(g==c, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
        for i in range(1,n+1):
            m=(lbl==i)
            r=np.where(m.any(1))[0]; co=np.where(m.any(0))[0]
            cells=set(zip(*np.where(m)))
            out.append(dict(c=int(c),r0=int(r[0]),c0=int(co[0]),cells=cells,area=len(cells)))
    return out

def match(a,b): return canon(a['cells'])==canon(b['cells'])

def cheb(A,B): return min(max(abs(a[0]-b[0]),abs(a[1]-b[1])) for a in A for b in B)

def transform(grid):
    gi=np.array(grid).copy(); objs=objects8(gi)
    for A in objs:
        cands=[(cheb(A['cells'],o['cells']),o) for o in objs if o['c']!=A['c']]
        if not cands: continue
        dmin=min(d for d,_ in cands)
        if dmin!=2: continue
        d2=[o for d,o in cands if d==2]
        if len(d2)!=1: continue
        twins=[T for T in objs if T is not A and match(T,A)]
        if len(twins)!=1: continue
        T=twins[0]; B=d2[0]
        if T['c']==B['c']: continue
        for (r,c) in T['cells']: gi[r,c]=B['c']
    return gi.tolist()
'''

def twins_of(o, objs):
    return [T for T in objs if T is not o and match(T,o)]

def firings(gi):
    gi=np.array(gi); objs=objects8(gi); out=[]
    for A in objs:
        for B in objs:
            if B['c']==A['c'] or cheb(A['cells'],B['cells'])!=2: continue
            tw=twins_of(B,objs)
            if len(tw)!=1: continue
            T=tw[0]
            if T['c']==A['c']: continue
            feats=dict(
                nnA = min((cheb(A['cells'],x['cells']) for x in objs if x['c']!=A['c']), default=None),
                nA = sum(1 for x in objs if x['c']==A['c']),
                nB = sum(1 for x in objs if x['c']==B['c']),
                nT = sum(1 for x in objs if x['c']==T['c']),
                areaA=A['area'],areaB=B['area'],areaT=T['area'],
                dAT=cheb(A['cells'],T['cells']),
                ar=A['r0'],ac=A['c0'],br=B['r0'],bc=B['c0'],tr=T['r0'],tc=T['c0'],
            )
            out.append((A,B,T,feats))
    return out

for i in range(1,7):
    n=f'Demo pair {i} input'; o=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} output']); gi=np.array(G[n])
    print('==',i)
    good=[]
    for A,B,T,f in firings(n):
        pred = o[T['cells'][:,0],T['cells'][:,1]]==A['c']
        tag = 'GOOD' if pred.all() else 'bad '
        if pred.all(): good.append((A,B,T))
        print(f" {tag} A {A['c']}@({A['r0']},{A['c0']}) B {B['c']}@({B['r0']},{B['c0']}) T {T['c']}@({T['r0']},{T['c0']})",

    # check reproduction using only good firings
    g2=gi.copy()
    for A,B,T in good:
        for rr,cc in T['cells']: g2[rr,cc]=A['c']
    print('   good-only reproduces:', g2.tolist()==o.tolist())

    g=np.array(g)
    if mode in ('rot','flip','full'): cands=[g, np.fliplr(g)]

    if mode in ('rot','full'):

    if mode=='flip': cands=[g, np.fliplr(g), np.flipud(g)]

def norm(g, mode):
    g=np.asarray(g)
    rs,cs=np.where(g!=0)
    g=g[rs.min():rs.max()+1, cs.min():cs.max()+1]
    fams=[]
    cands=[g]
    if mode in ('flip','full'): cands+=[np.fliplr(g),np.flipud(g),np.flipud(np.fliplr(g))]
    if mode in ('rot','full'):
        base=[g]+([np.fliplr(g)] if mode=='full' else [])
        for b in base:

    best=None
    for c in cands:

        if best is None or t<best[0]: best=(t,c.shape)

def R4(g, twinmode='exact', need_unique_twin=False, recolor_all=True):
    gi=tog(g); objs=objects8(gi)
    for o in objs:
        m=np.zeros(gi.shape,dtype=int)
        for rr,cc in cells_list(o): m[rr,cc]=1
        o['m']=m
        rs,cs=np.where(m); o['ctr']=(rs.mean(),cs.mean())
    def cdist(o1,o2): return np.hypot(o1['ctr'][0]-o2['ctr'][0], o1['ctr'][1]-o2['ctr'][1])
    singles=[o for o in objs if sum(1 for x in objs if x['c']==o['c'])==1]
    if not singles: return []
    # largest singleton is the anchor
    A=max(singles,key=lambda o:o['area'])
    # d2 objects
    d2=[o for o in objs if o['c']!=A['c'] and cheb(A['cells'],o['cells'])==2]
    d2.sort(key=lambda o:cdist(o,A))
    changes=[]
    for B in d2:
        tw=[T for T in objs if T is not B and norm(T['m'],twinmode)==norm(B['m'],twinmode) and T['c']!=A['c'] and T is not A]
        if not tw: continue
        if need_unique_twin and len(tw)!=1: continue
        if recolor_all:
            for T in tw: changes.append((A,B,T))
        else:
            changes.append((A,B,tw[0]))
        break  # only closest valid B
    return changes

def R5(g, twinmode='rot', recolor_all=True):
    gi=tog(g); objs=objects8(gi)
    for o in objs:
        m=np.zeros(gi.shape,dtype=int)
        for rr,cc in cells_list(o): m[rr,cc]=1
        o['m']=m; rs,cs=np.where(m); o['ctr']=(rs.mean(),cs.mean())
    def cdist(o1,o2): return float(np.hypot(o1['ctr'][0]-o2['ctr'][0], o1['ctr'][1]-o2['ctr'][1]))
    ccount=Counter(o['c'] for o in objs)
    cands=[]
    for A in objs:
        if ccount[A['c']]!=1: continue
        best=None
        for B in objs:
            if B['c']==A['c'] or cheb(A['cells'],B['cells'])!=2: continue
            tw=[T for T in objs if T is not B and T is not A and T['c']!=A['c']
                and norm(T['m'],twinmode)==norm(B['m'],twinmode)]
            if not tw: continue
            d=cdist(A,B)
            if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,B,tw)
        if best: cands.append((best[0],A,best[1],best[2]))
    if not cands: return []
    cands.sort(key=lambda t:t[0])
    _,A,B,tw=cands[0]
    return [(A,B,T) for T in (tw if recolor_all else tw[:1])]

for i in range(1,7):

        for rr,cc in cells_list(T): g2[rr,cc]=A['c']
    print(f'demo{i}: ok={g2.tolist()==o.tolist()}',
          [(A['c'],(A['r0'],A['c0']),B['c'],(B['r0'],B['c0']),T['c'],(T['r0'],T['c0'])) for A,B,T in ch])

import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
def cheb(A,B): return min(max(abs(a[0]-b[0]),abs(a[1]-b[1])) for a in A for b in B)
def objects8(g):
    g=np.array(g); bg=np.bincount(g.ravel()).argmax()
    lab,n=ndimage.label(g!=bg, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        cells=[tuple(x) for x in np.argwhere(lab==i)]
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        out.append(dict(c=int(g[cells[0]]), cells=cells, r0=min(rs), c0=min(cs), area=len(cells)))
    return out
def match(a,b):
    ca=sorted((r-a['r0'],c-a['c0']) for r,c in a['cells'])
    cb=sorted((r-b['r0'],c-b['c0']) for r,c in b['cells'])
    return ca==cb
def transform(grid):
    gi=np.array(grid).copy(); objs=objects8(gi)
    for A in objs:
        cands=[(cheb(A['cells'],o['cells']),o) for o in objs if o['c']!=A['c']]
        if not cands: continue
        dmin=min(d for d,_ in cands)
        if dmin!=2: continue
        d2=[o for d,o in cands if d==2]
        if len(d2)!=1: continue
        twins=[T for T in objs if T is not A and match(T,A)]
        if len(twins)!=1: continue
        T=twins[0]; B=d2[0]
        if T['c']==B['c']: continue
        for (r,c) in T['cells']: gi[r,c]=B['c']
    return gi.tolist()
